cues: Subnetting splits one network into several.
To make four subnets, borrow two host bits, since two squared is four.
The prefix becomes slash twenty six, mask two five five dot two five five dot two five five dot one nine two.
Each subnet has sixty four addresses, sixty two usable, starting at nought, sixty four, one twenty eight and one ninety two.
The second runs from sixty four, the network, to one twenty seven, the broadcast.
